correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the cyclic five-column local majority windows for GP(n,2), n>=5 to ensure 3 distinct neighbors, and the exact bijection F_n=tr(T^n) for 256-state transfer. Independent construction gave 320 edges, a 24-state recurrent strongly connected component and two singleton loops; symmetric/antisymmetric global spin sectors have exact integer characteristic factors t^3(t^9-t^8-t^7-t^4+2t^3+1) and t^3(t^9-t^8-t^7+2t^6-t^4-1). Independent exact Perron Collatz–Wielandt inequalities using B^60 1 establish 1.56485<alpha<1.56486. Primitivity and trace formula prove all-n root-sum count and entropy gap versus golden-ratio prism. Independent graph-state brute force n=5..8 reproduced GP2 [14,14,32,48] and GP1 [14,22,32,48]. Finite direct samples merely corroborate all-size transfer bijection.
